prompt: Which of these tasks can be completed entirely in Git on your own machine, with no GitHub connection?
explanation: Branching, staging, committing, merging, and inspecting history are local Git operations. Reviews, issues, notifications, and pull request conversations are GitHub features that need the hosting layer.

options.text: Creating a branch, staging files, and committing a snapshot
Requesting a review on a pull request
Filing an issue on a repository you do not own
